name_th: คิดถึงวันวาน
core_read: Warm, slightly faded memory of a past that feels safer than now; pleasure with a soft ache.

approaches.name: Faded keepsake still life
approaches.palette_direction: Sun-faded warm neutrals with lifted blacks: cream #EFE3C8, faded ochre #C9A46A, dusty teal #6E8E88, sepia brown #7A5A3C
approaches.character_expression: No face; or a face only inside an old photo on the table
approaches.body_language: A hand entering frame to touch a photo corner
approaches.environment: Wooden table with old photos, a cassette, a school badge, a pair of old round frames
approaches.negative_space: Wide margin of bare tabletop around the cluster
approaches.texture: Paper grain, scratched print emulsion, light dust
approaches.symbolism: Old photo = a moment kept; worn edges = years handled

approaches.name: Remembered street at dusk
approaches.palette_direction: Golden-orange haze over cool shadows: amber #E8A04C, rose #D98C7A, slate blue #4F6275
approaches.character_expression: Figure seen from behind, face unreadable
approaches.body_language: Standing still while others blur past, hands in pockets
approaches.environment: Old shophouse soi, a closed noodle stall, a bicycle
approaches.negative_space: Large glowing sky above the roofline
approaches.texture: Soft bloom, gentle grain, halation on highlights
approaches.visual_metaphor: The present self standing in the past
approaches.symbolism: Low sun = something ending; shuttered shop = what is gone

approaches.name: Double memory overlay
approaches.palette_direction: Two-temperature duotone: present cool grey #8C9399, past warm sepia #B08860, shared cream #F2E8D5
approaches.character_expression: Adult with soft, inward gaze, small half-smile
approaches.body_language: Head tilted, looking at a child version of self in the overlay
approaches.environment: Present room fading into a childhood room
approaches.negative_space: Quiet blank wall carrying the overlaid image
approaches.visual_metaphor: Then and now sharing one body
approaches.symbolism: Child figure = innocence; matching pose = continuity

contrast_levers: Warm vs cool temperature split; sharp present vs soft/grainy past; saturation lower in the memory layer.
cultural_notes: Thai nostalgia often reads through school uniforms, old shophouses, Thai-Chinese cafe tins, cassette/VCD era objects, 90s TV. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Fake film borders with random text
Modern phones sneaking into a 'past' scene
Over-orange grade that kills skin tones
eyewear_angle: Old round frames among the keepsakes beside a modern Time Optic frame: 'the way you see changes, the memories stay'.

name_th: โหยหา
core_read: Reaching toward something absent or far away; the gap itself is the subject.

approaches.name: Window gap
approaches.palette_direction: Cool interior blue-grey #3E4A57 against a warm distant light #F0B36B
approaches.character_expression: Eyes fixed beyond the glass, lips slightly parted
approaches.body_language: Palm resting flat on the glass, body leaning toward it
approaches.environment: Dim room, rain-specked window, distant lit city or village
approaches.negative_space: The window space between figure and light
approaches.visual_metaphor: Glass = an invisible wall to what is wanted
approaches.symbolism: Distant warm light = the thing longed for

approaches.name: Small figure, far horizon
approaches.palette_direction: Pale washed sea and sky: mist #D7DEE0, sea grey #8FA3A8, a single small coral point #E07A5F
approaches.character_expression: Too small to read; posture carries it
approaches.body_language: Standing at the edge of a pier, one foot forward
approaches.environment: Empty pier into mist, a faint boat at the horizon
approaches.symbolism: Departing boat = someone gone; pier end = the limit of reach

approaches.name: Empty object close-up
approaches.palette_direction: Muted dusk lilac #9A8FA8, cold white #EDEFF2, one warm object #C98B5A
approaches.body_language: Absent person implied by objects
approaches.environment: A second cup, a folded jacket on a chair, phone with an unanswered thread (no readable text)
approaches.visual_metaphor: What remains standing for who is missing

contrast_levers: Near (dark, cool) vs far (lit, warm); scale of figure vs space; one warm accent in a cool field.
cultural_notes: Long-distance family (work in Bangkok vs hometown in Isan) is a strong Thai longing theme; avoid cliché farewell-at-bus-station unless intended. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Tear on cheek at the window
ai_mistakes: Both figures visible, which kills the absence
Window reflections that don't match the room
Readable fake chat text on phones
eyewear_angle: Subtle: reflection of the distant light in a lens; tagline about seeing clearly what matters. Keep low-key, not a hard sell.

name_th: ความเปราะบาง
core_read: Exposed, unguarded, without armour; the viewer is trusted with something fragile.

approaches.name: Bare close portrait
approaches.palette_direction: Soft unretouched skin tones on pale neutral: bone #EDE6DC, skin warm #D9B59A, shadow taupe #8C7B70
approaches.character_expression: Eyes open and direct but not defiant, slight tension at the brow
approaches.body_language: Shoulders bare or soft-collared, chin slightly down
approaches.texture: Visible skin texture, pores, a stray hair

approaches.name: Curled small in big space
approaches.palette_direction: Cold pale field #DCE3E8 with a single soft warm figure #E3B89A
approaches.body_language: Sitting curled on the floor, arms around legs
approaches.environment: Large empty room with bare floor
approaches.negative_space: Most of the frame is empty floor
approaches.symbolism: High angle = viewer above, figure exposed

approaches.name: Cracked shell metaphor
approaches.palette_direction: Porcelain white #F4F1EC, hairline gold #C8A35A, inner warm glow #F2C27B
approaches.body_language: Hands open, palms up
approaches.negative_space: Dark ground around a lit, fragile figure
approaches.texture: Ceramic cracks repaired with gold (kintsugi-like) on a statue-like figure

contrast_levers: Hard environment vs soft subject; high-angle exposure vs eye-level trust; detail texture vs smooth ground.
cultural_notes: In Thai social context, open display of vulnerability in public is restrained; private settings (home, bedroom) read more natural. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Hands over face with dramatic backlight
ai_mistakes: Over-smoothed plastic skin defeats the 'unmasked' idea
eyewear_angle: Taking glasses off = unguarded moment; frame held in open hands. Good for gentle eye-care stories, not hard promo.

name_th: เข้าใจความรู้สึก
core_read: Feeling with someone; two people matched in posture and level, attention fully on the other.

approaches.name: Mirrored listening
approaches.palette_direction: Shared warm mid tones: clay #C08A6A, linen #EDE3D3, soft olive #8A8F6A
approaches.character_expression: Listener's brow slightly raised in concern, mirroring the speaker
approaches.body_language: Both leaning in, same height, knees angled toward each other
approaches.environment: Small kitchen table, two glasses of water

approaches.name: Shared colour bleed
approaches.palette_direction: Speaker's sad blue #5B7A99 bleeding into listener's warm #E2A87A, merging to lavender #A49AB8
approaches.character_expression: Simple faces; the colour carries emotion
approaches.body_language: Facing each other across the split line
approaches.visual_metaphor: Feeling crossing from one to another

approaches.name: Hand on hand detail
approaches.palette_direction: Low-key warm: deep umber #3B2A22, warm skin #C9936E, lamp gold #E8B86A
approaches.body_language: One hand resting over another on a table, thumb moving
approaches.environment: Edge of a table, a tissue box blurred

contrast_levers: Level vs unequal heights; warm shared light vs cold separate light; distance between bodies.
cultural_notes: Thai empathy often shown through small acts (bringing water, food) rather than hugging; touch between strangers is reserved. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Optometrist really listening to an elderly customer at eye level; shows care, suits trust-building content.

name_th: ปลอบโยน
core_read: Actively comforting someone in pain; one body sheltering another.

approaches.name: Shelter embrace
approaches.palette_direction: Warm protective tones around cool hurt: blanket ochre #C79A5B, cool grey-blue #6F8193, skin #D2A486
approaches.character_expression: Consoler's eyes soft, closed or lowered; hurt person's face buried
approaches.body_language: Arm wrapped around shoulders, heads touching
approaches.environment: Floor of a dim room, a blanket

approaches.name: Umbrella offered
approaches.palette_direction: Rain grey-blue #5E6E7C with one warm umbrella #D9824B
approaches.character_expression: Surprised, softening face of the person receiving
approaches.body_language: One person tilts the umbrella over the other, getting wet themselves
approaches.environment: Rainy Bangkok sidewalk, puddles reflecting lights
approaches.visual_metaphor: Covering someone at your own cost

approaches.name: Light carried to the dark
approaches.palette_direction: Deep night navy #1B2433 and a small lantern amber #F2B045
approaches.character_expression: Consoler kneeling, face lit from the lamp
approaches.body_language: Kneeling down to the level of a seated figure

contrast_levers: Warm consoler vs cool sufferer; enclosing shapes vs open; light pool vs dark field.
cultural_notes: Thai consoling is often quiet presence and touching the upper arm/back; monks or elders patting a head has specific hierarchy (head is sacred) — avoid a younger person touching an elder's head. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Shoulder to cry on with tissue stock
ai_mistakes: Face of the hurt person showing a smile
eyewear_angle: Gentle story: a staff member adjusting an elderly customer's new glasses with care. Never use grief itself to sell.

name_th: เห็นใจ
core_read: Feeling sorry for someone from a respectful slight distance; concern without full merging.

approaches.name: Watching from a step away
approaches.palette_direction: Desaturated soft neutrals: stone #B8B3AA, dusty blue #8796A5, warm cardigan #B88A6A
approaches.character_expression: Concerned brow, mouth closed, slight head tilt
approaches.body_language: Standing a little apart, hands clasped in front
approaches.environment: Hospital corridor or office, the other person seated in background focus
approaches.symbolism: Clasped hands = wanting to help, holding back

approaches.name: Offered object
approaches.palette_direction: Warm cup #D7A66F on cool grey table #9AA0A6
approaches.body_language: Hand sliding a cup of tea across a table

approaches.name: Soft rain line drawing
approaches.palette_direction: Ink on off-white #F5F2EA with one pale blue wash #A9C1D6
approaches.character_expression: Simple drawn eyes with lowered brows
approaches.body_language: One figure patting the other's back lightly
approaches.symbolism: Rain = trouble; patted back = 'I see you'

contrast_levers: Gap between figures (larger than empathy); mid-key softness vs high drama.
cultural_notes: Thai 'เห็นใจ' is often expressed as 'สู้ๆ นะ' — small gesture, not big embrace. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Pity looking down on a beggar
eyewear_angle: Low suitability for ads; can be used in eye-health awareness (e.g. empathy with someone struggling to read).

name_th: ประชด
core_read: Saying the opposite of what is meant; surface praise, visible mockery underneath.

approaches.name: Deadpan thumbs-up
approaches.palette_direction: Over-cheerful flat colours: candy pink #F4A6C0, sky #8FD3F4, with a flat unimpressed grey face lighting #9A9A9A
approaches.character_expression: Half-lidded eyes, flat mouth, one eyebrow up
approaches.body_language: Slow sarcastic clap or limp thumbs-up
approaches.environment: Party decorations behind a disaster (spilled cake)

approaches.name: Sign vs reality
approaches.palette_direction: Glossy ad palette #FFD54F #29B6F6 vs grim real #6D6D6D
approaches.character_expression: Figure standing in rain under a 'sunny day' sign, unamused
approaches.body_language: Arms crossed
approaches.environment: Billboard promising sunshine above a flooded soi

approaches.name: Side-eye close-up
approaches.character_expression: Eyes slid sideways toward the target, corner of mouth pulled into a tight smirk
approaches.body_language: Chin slightly raised
approaches.environment: Blurred background with the person being mocked
approaches.negative_space: Space on the side of the glance
approaches.visual_metaphor: Look that says the opposite of words

contrast_levers: Mismatch between bright set and flat face; text/sign vs reality; saturation used ironically.
cultural_notes: Thai ประชด is common in memes; meme-face conventions (e.g. sticker-style side-eyes) read instantly online but keep it non-hostile for brand use. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: AI renders a genuine smile so sarcasm reads as real joy
Text in sign gets garbled — render sign text in HTML layer
eyewear_angle: Light humour: 'Sure, squinting is cool' with a squinting person, then clear glasses. Keep self-deprecating, not mocking customers.

name_th: ประชดเรียบๆ
core_read: Understated, knowing mismatch; no punchline face, the image itself is quietly absurd.

approaches.name: Deadpan tableau
approaches.palette_direction: Muted pastel Wes-style flatness without copying: mint #BFD8C8, salmon #E8A99A, cream #F3E9D2
approaches.body_language: Stiff upright posture, hands at sides
approaches.environment: Perfectly arranged room with one absurd detail (an umbrella open indoors)

approaches.name: Small sign, big fact
approaches.palette_direction: Grey concrete #9C9C98 and a tiny yellow #E9C440
approaches.body_language: None
approaches.environment: Huge empty car park with one tiny 'reserved' cone

approaches.name: Understated line comic
approaches.palette_direction: Black ink on white #FFFFFF with one grey tone #BDBDBD
approaches.body_language: Same pose repeated while the world changes

contrast_levers: Neutral face vs absurd context; symmetry vs a single break.
cultural_notes: Subtle irony can be missed in Thai casual feed scrolling; pair with clear setup. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Too many absurd details dilute the joke
eyewear_angle: Clean symmetric shop counter, customer reading menu at arm's length with deadpan face. Light, tasteful.

name_th: แซวเล่น
core_read: Affectionate poking fun; grin, closeness, both parties in on the game.

approaches.name: Poke and grin
approaches.character_expression: Teaser grinning with scrunched eyes; target pretending offence but smiling
approaches.body_language: Leaning in, finger poking a cheek or nudge with shoulder

approaches.name: Stolen hat
approaches.body_language: One holding something above the other's reach

approaches.name: Whisper-to-camera
approaches.character_expression: Cheeky smirk to viewer, eyebrows up
approaches.body_language: Hand partly covering mouth, gesturing at friend behind
approaches.environment: Friend in background unaware with food on face

contrast_levers: Warm bright palette vs cold mockery; closeness and mutual smiles distinguish it from mockery.
cultural_notes: Thai 'แซว' is a core social bonding mode; online it pairs with playful stickers. Keep body contact appropriate. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Target looks genuinely hurt (turns into bullying)
Too many limbs in the poke
eyewear_angle: Friend trying on each other's glasses and teasing — great for frame try-on posts.

name_th: เยาะเย้ย
core_read: Belittling with contempt; power imbalance, laughter at someone, not with.

approaches.name: Laughing crowd vs one
approaches.palette_direction: Sour yellow-green #B5B84A, harsh white #F2F2F2, isolated cold figure #5A6B80
approaches.character_expression: Crowd with open-mouth laughter, pointing; target small, head down
approaches.body_language: Group leaning back, pointing

approaches.name: Mask grin
approaches.palette_direction: Garish red #D7263D and black #111111 on paper white
approaches.body_language: Head tilted back

approaches.name: Caricature sketch
approaches.character_expression: Drawn mocker smirking with chin up
approaches.body_language: Hand mimicking a 'talking mouth' puppet

contrast_levers: Power: high angle on victim, low angle on mocker; harsh hard light vs soft.
cultural_notes: Bullying imagery is sensitive; Thai platforms often report it. Use only in story context showing it as wrong. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads (except anti-bullying story, e.g. kid teased for glasses, later confident).

name_th: กังขา
core_read: Doubting a claim; examining, not believing yet.

approaches.name: Raised eyebrow inspection
approaches.palette_direction: Cool neutral: grey-blue #7C8B99, paper #ECEAE4, a hint of mustard #C8A646
approaches.character_expression: One eyebrow raised, lips pursed to one side
approaches.body_language: Holding an object at arm's length, head pulled back
approaches.visual_metaphor: Holding something at a distance to judge it

approaches.name: Magnifier on claim
approaches.body_language: Hand holding a magnifier over fine print

approaches.name: Crossed arms in shadow
approaches.palette_direction: Low-key slate #2E3438 and a pale key #D6D2C8
approaches.body_language: Arms crossed, weight back on heels

contrast_levers: Distance between face and object; cool palette; half-light vs open light.
cultural_notes: Thai consumers are skeptical of 'too good' promos; showing proof (lens test) answers skepticism. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Eyebrow asymmetry rendered as a deformity
eyewear_angle: Great setup: skeptical customer holding a lens to light, then a proof shot (lens reflection control). Suits product-truth content.

name_th: ระแวง
core_read: Distrust of someone's intent; watching, guarded, expecting a trick.

approaches.name: Through the blinds
approaches.character_expression: Narrowed eyes peeking, face striped by shadow
approaches.body_language: Fingers parting blinds

approaches.name: Over-shoulder glance
approaches.character_expression: Eyes turned back over shoulder, mouth tight
approaches.body_language: Clutching a bag close, body turned away
approaches.environment: Night street with a figure in the distance

approaches.name: Eyes in the dark
approaches.palette_direction: Near black #121314 with eye-level slit of light #E6E1D4
approaches.body_language: None visible

contrast_levers: Narrow slit light vs open; side-glance eyelines; tight framing.
cultural_notes: Thai drama (ละคร) uses exaggerated suspicious side-glances; tone down for realism. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Lightly: a cat suspicious of new glasses on the table. Otherwise not suitable for ads.

name_th: ตั้งป้อมปกป้องตัวเอง
core_read: Guarding self against criticism; closed body, barriers, pushed-back posture.

approaches.name: Barrier pose
approaches.palette_direction: Tense cool: steel blue #4D6A84, harsh white #F0F0F0, flushed cheek #D58A7A
approaches.character_expression: Jaw set, chin tucked, eyes defensive
approaches.body_language: Arms crossed high, shoulders raised, body angled away
approaches.environment: Office or family dining table, an object (bag/laptop) held as shield

approaches.name: Fortress metaphor
approaches.body_language: Standing in the centre of a self-built wall of books/boxes

approaches.name: Pointing back
approaches.palette_direction: Hot red #C9383A pushing against cool blue #3E6990
approaches.body_language: Hand raised palm-out, other hand on chest

contrast_levers: Closed vs open body; barrier objects; tight frames.
cultural_notes: Thai face-saving (รักษาหน้า) makes defensiveness often quieter: smiling while stiff. Show stiffness in shoulders. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Crossed arms with wrong number of hands
eyewear_angle: Story only: a teen refusing glasses arms crossed, later chooses a frame they like. Light touch.

name_th: ขุ่นเคืองต่อความไม่ยุติธรรม
core_read: Righteous anger at injustice; upright, principled, aimed at a wrong, not a person's ego.

approaches.name: Standing up
approaches.palette_direction: Firm reds and deep blue: brick red #B23A2E, navy #1E2F4F, paper #EDE6D6
approaches.character_expression: Brow lowered, eyes direct, mouth firm
approaches.body_language: Standing straight, rising from a seat, one fist at side

approaches.name: Broken scale
approaches.body_language: A hand slamming the higher pan of scales

approaches.name: Protest crowd silhouette
approaches.palette_direction: Sunset orange #E86A33 sky behind black #161616 silhouettes
approaches.body_language: Raised arms

contrast_levers: Upright verticals vs slumped; warm/red accents controlled, not chaotic like rage.
cultural_notes: Political protest imagery is sensitive in Thailand (raised three-finger salute etc.). Avoid real political symbols in brand work. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Rage expressions instead of controlled resolve
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads; maybe consumer-rights framing ('you deserve accurate lenses') without anger imagery.

name_th: เจ็บเพราะถูกหักหลัง
core_read: Shock and wound from someone trusted; trust broken, the betrayer often present or implied.

approaches.name: Turned back
approaches.palette_direction: Cold blue #3D5672, desaturated skin #C2A595, a fading warm memory #D7A37A
approaches.character_expression: Wounded, wide unfocused eyes, lips parted
approaches.body_language: Hand to chest, body stepping back
approaches.environment: Background figure walking away or embracing someone else

approaches.name: Torn photo
approaches.palette_direction: Faded polaroid warm #E0C49C torn across to reveal grey #6E6E6E
approaches.body_language: Hands holding the two halves

approaches.name: Knife-shaped shadow
approaches.body_language: Two figures hugging, one shadow on wall holds a blade

contrast_levers: Warm-to-cold shift; distance increasing; truth in shadows vs surface.
cultural_notes: Thai lakorn betrayal tropes (slap, tears) are overused; subtle stillness reads more modern. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Betrayer depicted ambiguous so story unclear
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: ขมขื่น
core_read: Long-held resentment gone sour; anger aged into a stale, sour stillness.

approaches.name: Cold coffee
approaches.character_expression: Mouth turned down, tight lips, eyes looking off
approaches.body_language: Slouched in chair, fingers drumming
approaches.environment: Old kitchen, cold cup with skin on top, stacked bills

approaches.name: Withered plant
approaches.body_language: Hand holding a dead flower stem

approaches.name: Sour face portrait
approaches.character_expression: Sneer-tight lips, deep set lines, narrowed eyes
approaches.body_language: Head turned slightly away

contrast_levers: Muted sour greens/browns vs hot reds of anger; stillness vs action.
cultural_notes: In Thai culture, bitterness (แค้น) is a classic lakorn engine; family bitterness over inheritance etc. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Over-aged face as default for bitterness
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: ยอมจำนน
core_read: Giving up; the fight is over, energy drained, quiet surrender to circumstance.

approaches.name: Slumped at the end
approaches.body_language: Sitting on stairs, hands hanging between knees
approaches.environment: Empty stairwell or bus stop at dusk

approaches.name: Drifting boat
approaches.body_language: Person lying back in an oarless boat

approaches.name: Dropped tools
approaches.body_language: Hands resting open beside dropped tools/papers

contrast_levers: Downward lines and slack shapes vs upright; desaturation.
cultural_notes: Buddhist acceptance vs resignation differ: resignation is defeated, acceptance is at peace — keep the slump to read resignation. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: ยอมรับได้
core_read: Peaceful letting go; reality met with equanimity, not defeat.

approaches.name: Open palms at dawn
approaches.palette_direction: Soft dawn: pale peach #F2D2B6, lavender #C9BEDD, mist #E7ECEE
approaches.character_expression: Eyes closed or soft, faint smile, relaxed jaw
approaches.body_language: Sitting upright, palms open on knees, shoulders dropped
approaches.environment: Riverbank or temple courtyard at dawn

approaches.name: Leaf on water
approaches.palette_direction: Jade water #6F9C8E and a golden leaf #D9A845
approaches.body_language: A hand releasing a leaf into a stream

approaches.name: Kintsugi bowl
approaches.palette_direction: Earth stoneware #8C7B6A with gold seam #C7A24A on linen #EDE6DA
approaches.body_language: Two hands cradling a repaired bowl

contrast_levers: Upright relaxed posture vs slump; warm light returning vs cold flat.
cultural_notes: Thai Buddhist ปล่อยวาง (letting go) imagery — lotus, monk, temple — is fitting but avoid using monks commercially. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Meditating silhouette on a mountain at sunset
eyewear_angle: Gentle: older customer accepting reading glasses with a smile ('สายตายาวตามวัย'). Very suitable.

name_th: ลังเล
core_read: Paused between options; weight caught mid-shift, the moment before choosing.

approaches.name: Door threshold
approaches.character_expression: Face partly lit, lips pressed, eyes on the doorway
approaches.body_language: Hand on the frame, one foot forward, weight back

approaches.name: Hovering hand
approaches.palette_direction: Two clear options in cool #6BA3C9 and warm #E8A15A on neutral #E8E4DC
approaches.body_language: Fingertip hovering between two objects (two frames)

approaches.name: Forked path
approaches.body_language: Standing at the fork

contrast_levers: Balanced symmetric options vs a tilt toward one; light ahead vs dark behind.
cultural_notes: Thai เกรงใจ often looks like hesitation too; context decides. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Hand actually touching one option (decision already made)
Fork path looks like a road map clipart
eyewear_angle: Very suitable: customer's hand hovering between two frames, staff helping. Classic try-on content.

name_th: ประหม่า
core_read: Jittery anticipation; mild fear before something (interview, stage), fidgeting.

approaches.name: Fidget detail
approaches.palette_direction: Cool pale greens #BFD3C4, sweaty skin #E0BFA8, clammy white #F4F4F0
approaches.character_expression: Out of frame or biting lip
approaches.body_language: Fingers twisting a strap, knee bouncing
approaches.symbolism: Fidget = energy with nowhere to go

approaches.name: Backstage peek
approaches.body_language: Clutching a script to chest, peeking from curtain

approaches.name: Wobbly line character
approaches.character_expression: Big eyes, wavy mouth, sweat drops
approaches.body_language: Knees knocking, shoulders raised

contrast_levers: Tight raised shoulders vs relaxed; cool pale vs warm.
cultural_notes: Manga sweat-drop conventions are widely understood in Thailand. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Knees literally knocking with motion lines everywhere (unless cartoon)
eyewear_angle: First eye exam for a child, slightly nervous, then smiling. Light, suitable.

name_th: หมดความอดทน / ใจร้อน
core_read: Annoyed by waiting; time pressure turned into small irritated motions.

approaches.name: Watch tap
approaches.body_language: Tapping a wristwatch, foot tapping

approaches.name: Endless queue
approaches.body_language: Long line snaking

approaches.name: Melting clock nod
approaches.body_language: Arms crossed, toe tapping

contrast_levers: Repetition and motion marks vs stillness; warm agitated accent.
cultural_notes: Thai ใจร้อน is a known trait in traffic/queues; keep it humorous. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Light humour: customer impatient for glasses; 'ready in 1 hour' message in HTML layer. Suitable.

name_th: เร่งด่วน

approaches.name: Hand-cupped whisper
approaches.character_expression: Whisperer's eyes darting, listener's eyes widening
approaches.body_language: Hand cupped to ear, heads close

approaches.name: Finger to lips at viewer
approaches.palette_direction: Deep teal #0F4C5C and a peach #EFCF9C accent
approaches.character_expression: Knowing smile, raised brow, eye contact
approaches.body_language: Index finger to lips

approaches.name: Huddle from above
approaches.body_language: Kids huddled around a flashlight

contrast_levers: Closeness, darkness around, single warm light.
cultural_notes: Thai gossip (เมาท์) culture is playful; keep it light. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Brand: 'secret' new collection teaser with finger-to-lips, peach accent. Tasteful, suitable.

name_th: สงบจนน่าขนลุก
core_read: Too still, too quiet; calm that signals something wrong.

approaches.name: Empty perfect room
approaches.palette_direction: Pale sterile #E9ECEB, mint #C6D9CF, a single black #111 doorway
approaches.body_language: Sitting perfectly upright, hands on knees
approaches.environment: Symmetric room, nothing out of place

approaches.name: Fog lake with figure
approaches.body_language: Figure standing in still water

approaches.name: Calm narrator under green light
approaches.body_language: Hands folded

contrast_levers: Excess symmetry/stillness; muted palette with one dark anomaly.
cultural_notes: Thai horror often uses quiet spaces (old house, temple at night); avoid real temples in horror. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Calm reads as peaceful (needs one wrong detail)
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads.

name_th: ความอบอุ่นของคนเล่าเรื่อง
core_read: Grandparent-by-the-fire narration; inviting, cosy, audience leaning in.

approaches.name: Fireside circle
approaches.character_expression: Teller smiling, eyebrows lifted mid-story; children rapt
approaches.body_language: Teller's hand gesturing, listeners leaning in
approaches.environment: Thai wooden house veranda at night

approaches.name: Open storybook world
approaches.palette_direction: Pages cream #F5ECD7 with a watercolour world rising #8FB9A8 #E9A87C
approaches.body_language: Fingers turning a page, scene rising from book

approaches.name: Narrator to camera
approaches.body_language: Leaning forward in armchair

contrast_levers: Warm practical light, circular grouping, leaning bodies.
cultural_notes: Thai grandparents' tales (นิทาน) on the veranda; ร้านแว่นตีสอง night-shop narrator fits. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Night-optic series narrator; brand storytelling. Very suitable.

name_th: ขายของอย่างกระตือรือร้น
core_read: Bright, energetic presenting of a product; open, inviting, high energy without being pushy.

approaches.name: Product hero with presenter
approaches.palette_direction: Clean bright with brand accent: snow #FAFAFA, phthalo #123A29, peach #EFCF9C
approaches.character_expression: Genuine smile with crinkled eyes, eyebrows raised
approaches.body_language: Presenting frame on open palm toward camera, slight lean in

approaches.name: Energetic burst
approaches.body_language: Jumping with product raised

approaches.name: Elegant demo
approaches.palette_direction: Dark gradient #212121 to #3A3A3A with lens glint
approaches.body_language: Hands unfolding temples with flourish

contrast_levers: Bright key vs dark luxury; energy (radial) vs elegance (centre).
cultural_notes: Thai live-selling (ไลฟ์ขายของ) energy is familiar; keep brand calmer and premium. Ask price each time; text in HTML. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Pointing at viewer with fingers guns
eyewear_angle: Core use: presenting a frame. Prefer approach 1 or 3 for brand tone.

name_th: ผู้เชี่ยวชาญที่ไว้ใจได้
core_read: Calm competence; clean environment, steady eye contact, tools of craft visible.

approaches.name: Optometrist portrait
approaches.palette_direction: Clean clinic whites #F7F7F5, phthalo green #123A29, timberwolf #D9D4CB
approaches.character_expression: Calm confident small smile, direct gaze
approaches.body_language: Upright, arms relaxed, holding a trial frame

approaches.name: Hands at work
approaches.body_language: Adjusting a frame with precision pliers

approaches.name: Explaining diagram
approaches.palette_direction: Light diagram style #FAFAFA with green #123A29 lines
approaches.body_language: Pointing at an eye diagram

contrast_levers: Clean, even, stable light; eye-level; tools present.
cultural_notes: Thai customers trust white coats and certificates; avoid implying medical claims you can't support. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Core brand use for eye-test/lens advice. Very suitable.

name_th: แสดงความเสียใจอย่างเป็นทางการ
core_read: Respectful, restrained mourning; formal, quiet, symbolic.

approaches.name: Black and white with single flower
approaches.palette_direction: Black #111111, white #F5F5F5, a single white jasmine/marigold accent
approaches.body_language: Hands in a low wai

approaches.name: Ribbon
approaches.body_language: None

approaches.name: Candle row
approaches.body_language: Row of candles

contrast_levers: Restraint: desaturated, symmetric, minimal.
cultural_notes: Thai mourning: black/white dress, national mourning periods require brands to use black-and-white posts; avoid commercial elements entirely. Royal mourning has specific conventions — follow official guidance. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads. Condolence posts: no product, small logo only if appropriate.

name_th: ไม่แยแส
core_read: Not caring; flat affect, disengaged body, looking elsewhere.

approaches.name: Scrolling while world burns
approaches.palette_direction: Flat greys #9B9B9B with chaotic background orange #E67E22
approaches.body_language: Slumped, one hand in pocket

approaches.name: Turned shoulder
approaches.body_language: Shoulder turned to someone talking

approaches.name: Shrug sketch
approaches.body_language: Shrug, palms up

contrast_levers: Flat light and low saturation on subject vs active background.
cultural_notes: Thai 'ช่างมัน / เฉยๆ' can be laid-back rather than cold; context decides. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Not suitable for ads (except contrast setup: indifferent → interested when trying a frame).

name_th: ความลึกลับ
core_read: Something withheld; partial information that pulls the viewer in.

approaches.name: Fog path
approaches.body_language: Walking into fog

approaches.name: Half-lit face
approaches.body_language: Still

approaches.name: Lit doorway in dark
approaches.body_language: Door ajar with light

contrast_levers: Hide information: shadow, fog, crop; one light source.
cultural_notes: Thai night shophouses, old wooden houses, mist in northern mountains (ทะเลหมอก). Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Teaser: frame half in shadow, only lens edge glints. Suitable for launch teasers.

name_th: ความอบอุ่น
core_read: Comfort, kindness, human closeness; warm light and soft forms.

approaches.name: Shared meal
approaches.body_language: Passing dishes

approaches.name: Morning window light
approaches.body_language: Hands around mug

approaches.name: Knitted illustration
approaches.body_language: Wrapped in scarf

contrast_levers: Warm colour temperature, soft shadows, close grouping.
cultural_notes: In Thai context warmth reads through family meals, เติมน้ำ gestures; heat itself isn't always pleasant — avoid harsh sun. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Family choosing glasses together in warm light. Very suitable.

name_th: ความกล้าหาญ
core_read: Acting despite fear; facing a larger threat, stepping forward.

approaches.name: Small vs storm
approaches.palette_direction: Storm slate #3A4552 with a bright figure accent #E5A540
approaches.body_language: Stepping forward into wind

approaches.name: First step
approaches.body_language: Foot stepping off the edge onto a bridge

approaches.name: Raised hand in class
approaches.palette_direction: Classroom pastels #DDE8D0 with one bright uniform accent
approaches.body_language: One hand up among seated kids

contrast_levers: Small figure vs large threat; forward motion; light on the subject.
cultural_notes: Thai 'กล้า' scenes: school, first job; avoid military heroics. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
eyewear_angle: Shy kid confident in new glasses, raising hand. Suitable.

name_th: ความสงบเมื่ออยู่คนเดียว
core_read: Alone and content; space as comfort, not loneliness.

approaches.name: Reading nook
approaches.body_language: Curled with book and tea

approaches.name: Lone boat at dawn
approaches.body_language: Fishing calmly

approaches.name: Rooftop evening
approaches.palette_direction: Blue hour #42567A with warm city lights #F2B860
approaches.body_language: Sitting with headphones

contrast_levers: Warm light on lone figure (vs cold for loneliness); open relaxed posture.
cultural_notes: Solitude may read as loneliness in collectivist contexts; add contentment cues (smile, tea, hobby). Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Figure facing away with slumped back
eyewear_angle: Reading with comfortable glasses on a rainy afternoon. Very suitable.

name_th: ความยิ่งใหญ่สง่างาม
core_read: Grand, dignified scale; looking up at something noble.

approaches.name: Temple at golden hour
approaches.body_language: Small figures at base

approaches.name: Mountain range
approaches.body_language: Tiny hiker

approaches.name: Hero product monument
approaches.body_language: Frame standing upright like a monument

contrast_levers: Low angle, symmetry, scale contrast, gold/deep tones.
cultural_notes: Thai temples and royal imagery are sacred — never use royal symbols or Buddha images commercially; temple architecture in ads should be respectful. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
ai_mistakes: Fake architecture details mixed from different cultures
eyewear_angle: Premium frame on plinth with gold rim light (approach 3). Suitable for luxury lines.

name_th: ความอบอุ่นสบาย (cosy)
core_read: Small, soft, safe, enclosed; comfort objects and warm low light.

approaches.name: Blanket and rain
approaches.palette_direction: Warm cream #F2E3C6, cocoa #6B4A35, rain blue #7D93A8 outside
approaches.body_language: Wrapped in blanket with cocoa

approaches.name: Tiny café isometric
approaches.body_language: Barista and customer

approaches.name: Cat on lap close-up
approaches.body_language: Hand stroking a sleeping cat

contrast_levers: Enclosure, soft textures, warm small lights vs cold outside.
cultural_notes: Thai rainy season (หน้าฝน) gives a natural cosy setting; tropical heat means blankets read as AC-room cosy. Colour meanings depend on context (ElliotMaier2014).
cliches_to_avoid: Fireplace and snow in a Thai scene
eyewear_angle: Reading glasses beside a book and cocoa on a rainy evening. Very suitable.
